commands.text:
set -euo pipefail

  -e AI_JAM_HOME=/data \
  -v ajs-ci-journal:/data \
  --entrypoint node \
  ai-jam-sessions:ci \
  --input-type=module \
  -e "import { appendJournalEntry } from './dist/journal.js'; const p = appendJournalEntry('ci journal proof\n'); console.log(p);"
docker run --rm \
  -e AI_JAM_HOME=/data \
  -v ajs-ci-journal:/data \
  --entrypoint node \
  ai-jam-sessions:ci \
  --input-type=module \
  -e "import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; import { journalDir } from './dist/state-home.js'; const dir = journalDir(); const files = readdirSync(dir); const text = files.map((f) => readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8')).join('\n'); if (!text.includes('ci journal proof')) { console.error('journal missing'); process.exit(1); } console.log('journal survived across containers:', files.join(', '));"

set -euo pipefail
echo "Mode: $MODE"
echo "Confirm token: <redacted>"
case "$MODE" in
  draft-only)
    echo "→ Will create a Zenodo DRAFT, upload archives, set metadata. No DOI mint. No HF push."
    ;;
  publish-zenodo-only)
    if [ "$CONFIRM" != "yes-mint-doi" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: mode=publish-zenodo-only requires confirm_irreversible=yes-mint-doi"
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "→ Will create Zenodo draft + PUBLISH (mint DOI). No HF push."
    ;;
  publish)
    if [ "$CONFIRM" != "yes-mint-doi" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: mode=publish requires confirm_irreversible=yes-mint-doi"
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "→ Will create Zenodo draft + PUBLISH (mint DOI) + push to HuggingFace."
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: unknown mode: $MODE"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Printed here, before checkout or any Zenodo call, so the choice is
# on the log's first screen. "none" is the reachable fresh-deposit
# sentinel; GitHub replaces an empty dispatch value with the default.
if [ "$NEWVERSION_OF" = "none" ]; then
  echo "Zenodo path: fresh deposit"
elif printf '%s' "$NEWVERSION_OF" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'; then
  echo "Zenodo path: new version of $NEWVERSION_OF"
else
  echo "ERROR: zenodo_newversion_of must be all digits (a published record id) or \"none\" (fresh deposit); got: $NEWVERSION_OF"
  exit 1
fi

set -euo pipefail
DIR="${DATASET_DIR:-datasets/jam-actions-v0-public}"
if ! printf '%s' "$DIR" | grep -Eq '^datasets/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'; then
  echo "ERROR: dataset_dir must be datasets/<package-name> (got: $DIR)"
  exit 1
fi
test -d "$DIR" || { echo "ERROR: no such dataset package: $DIR"; exit 1; }
test -f "$DIR/VERSION" || { echo "ERROR: missing $DIR/VERSION"; exit 1; }
test -f "$DIR/checksums.sha256" || { echo "ERROR: missing $DIR/checksums.sha256"; exit 1; }
test -f "$DIR/zenodo-metadata.json" || { echo "ERROR: missing $DIR/zenodo-metadata.json"; exit 1; }

PKG=$(basename "$DIR")
VER=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$DIR/VERSION")
if [ -z "$VER" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: $DIR/VERSION is empty"
  exit 1
fi

# v0 draft-only still creates a Zenodo DRAFT (unchanged). Any other
# package with mode=draft-only stops before any Zenodo call.
SKIP_ZENODO=false
if [ "$MODE" = "draft-only" ] && [ "$DIR" != "datasets/jam-actions-v0-public" ]; then
  SKIP_ZENODO=true
fi

{
  echo "dir=$DIR"
  echo "pkg=$PKG"
  echo "version=$VER"
  echo "skip_zenodo=$SKIP_ZENODO"
  echo "metadata=$DIR/zenodo-metadata.json"
  echo "artifact=${PKG}-${VER}-archives"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

echo "Dataset dir: $DIR"
echo "Package:     $PKG"
echo "Version:     $VER"
echo "Archives:    artifacts/${PKG}-${VER}.tar.gz + .zip"
echo "Artifact:    ${PKG}-${VER}-archives"
echo "Metadata:    $DIR/zenodo-metadata.json"
if [ "$SKIP_ZENODO" = "true" ]; then
  echo "→ draft-only for $DIR: archives + metadata payload as artifacts. No Zenodo call. No token used."
else
  echo "→ Zenodo path enabled for $DIR (mode=$MODE)."
fi
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

set -euo pipefail
if [ "$DIR" = "datasets/jam-actions-v0-public" ]; then
  pnpm exec tsx scripts/verify-public-package-checksums.ts
else
  echo "No v0 package-inputs verifier for $DIR; verifying checksums.sha256 directly."
  ( cd "$DIR" && sha256sum -c checksums.sha256 --quiet )
  echo "[ok] checksums.sha256 verified for $DIR"
fi

commands.step: Verify release gate (sealed Slice-21 baseline and sources from git history)
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
SLICE21_NAME="evals/slice21-fair-e3-baseline-results.json"
if [ "$DIR" = "datasets/jam-actions-v0-public" ]; then
  SEALED_REF="jam-actions-v0-feature-marketed-2026-05-19"
  SEALED_SHA="5bb5b2244b0bb03dc38a9235804ac71468084e3881ead6c823a79197d25b8e23"
  git show "${SEALED_REF}:datasets/jam-actions-v0-public/${SLICE21_NAME}" \
    > /tmp/slice21-fair-e3-baseline-results.json
  echo "${SEALED_SHA}  /tmp/slice21-fair-e3-baseline-results.json" | sha256sum -c -
  mkdir -p /tmp/sealed-gate/evals
  while read -r SHA NAME; do
    git show "${SEALED_REF}:datasets/jam-actions-v0-public/evals/${NAME}" > "/tmp/sealed-gate/evals/${NAME}"
    echo "${SHA}  /tmp/sealed-gate/evals/${NAME}" | sha256sum -c -
  done <<'PINS'
995c52c3b8e52aef4878e87c4e5a088a75f24b4d2bc248738dcf4f54380f4143 slice21-schumann-m045-rerun-results.json
d36dfd5dd4ed3ba725e0662b9b4ce9f22b5d36caed0105934c90433875a63b06 slice18-5-e3-post-repair-results.json
d471502b0d83079e1cfda146ecb9a5bd4b5935e835f8b8aa326b8ebd3b4d148c slice19-e3-tool-fresh-results.json
PINS
  pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-release-gate.ts /tmp/slice21-fair-e3-baseline-results.json \
    --artifacts-root /tmp/sealed-gate
elif [ -f "$DIR/$SLICE21_NAME" ]; then
  echo "Found $DIR/$SLICE21_NAME — running the release-gate validator on the packaged file."
  pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-release-gate.ts "$DIR/$SLICE21_NAME"
else
  echo "Skipping Verify release gate (sealed Slice-21 baseline from git history): $SLICE21_NAME is not present under $DIR"
fi

set -euo pipefail
RECEIPT="$DIR/evals/v${VER}-execution-verification.json"
if [ -f "$RECEIPT" ]; then
  VERDICT=$(jq -r '.verdict' "$RECEIPT")
  FAILS=$(jq -r '.failures | length' "$RECEIPT")
  UNIQUE=$(jq -r '.unique_calls' "$RECEIPT")
  EXECUTED=$(jq -r '.executed' "$RECEIPT")
  echo "Receipt: verdict=$VERDICT failures=$FAILS executed=$EXECUTED/$UNIQUE"
  [ "$VERDICT" = "PASS" ] || { echo "ERROR: receipt verdict is not PASS"; exit 1; }
  [ "$FAILS" = "0" ] || { echo "ERROR: receipt has failures"; exit 1; }
  [ "$EXECUTED" = "$UNIQUE" ] || { echo "ERROR: receipt executed != unique calls"; exit 1; }
elif [ "$DIR" = "datasets/jam-actions-v0-public" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: missing $RECEIPT"
  exit 1
else
  echo "Skipping Verify execution-verification receipt (cut-time standing gate): $RECEIPT is not present under $DIR"
fi

commands.step: Verify library evidence (no public record without a licence)
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
pnpm exec vitest run src/dataset/published-evidence.test.ts

set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p artifacts
(cd "$DIR" && tar -czf "../../artifacts/${PKG}-${VER}.tar.gz" .)
(cd datasets && zip -qr "../artifacts/${PKG}-${VER}.zip" "$PKG")

TAR_SHA=$(sha256sum "artifacts/${PKG}-${VER}.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)
ZIP_SHA=$(sha256sum "artifacts/${PKG}-${VER}.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "tar_sha=$TAR_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "zip_sha=$ZIP_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "tar=artifacts/${PKG}-${VER}.tar.gz" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "zip=artifacts/${PKG}-${VER}.zip" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

echo "Archives:"
ls -la artifacts/
echo "tar.gz sha256: $TAR_SHA"
echo "zip    sha256: $ZIP_SHA"

set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p artifacts-meta
# zenodo-metadata.json ALREADY has the { "metadata": {...} } envelope.
# We only need to strip the leading $schema_note (a documentation field) so
# Zenodo doesn't see an unknown top-level key. Do NOT re-wrap.
jq 'del(.["$schema_note"])' "$META" > artifacts-meta/zenodo-metadata-payload.json
echo "Metadata payload top-level keys:"
jq 'keys' artifacts-meta/zenodo-metadata-payload.json
echo "Inner metadata keys:"
jq '.metadata | keys' artifacts-meta/zenodo-metadata-payload.json

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${ZEN_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: ZEN_TOKEN secret is not set"
  exit 1
fi

if [ "${NEWVERSION_OF}" = "none" ]; then
  echo "Creating FRESH deposit (new concept DOI)..."
  DEPOSIT=$(curl --fail-with-body -sSL -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{}' \
    "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions")
elif printf '%s' "${NEWVERSION_OF:-}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'; then
  echo "Creating NEW VERSION draft of published record $NEWVERSION_OF..."
  NV_RESP=$(curl --fail-with-body -sSL -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
    "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$NEWVERSION_OF/actions/newversion")
  DRAFT_URL=$(echo "$NV_RESP" | jq -r '.links.latest_draft')
  if [ -z "$DRAFT_URL" ] || [ "$DRAFT_URL" = "null" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: newversion response carried no links.latest_draft"
    echo "$NV_RESP" | jq '{id, state, submitted, links}'
    exit 1
  fi
  DEPOSIT=$(curl --fail-with-body -sSL \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
    "$DRAFT_URL")
  DEPOSIT_ID=$(echo "$DEPOSIT" | jq -r '.id')

  # Delete the files Zenodo copied over from the previous version —
  # this version ships only its own archives. (Draft-only operation;
  # the published prior version's files are immutable.)
  echo "$DEPOSIT" | jq -r '.files[]?.id' | while read -r FID; do
    [ -n "$FID" ] || continue
    echo "  deleting inherited draft file $FID"
    curl --fail-with-body -sSL -X DELETE \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
      "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$DEPOSIT_ID/files/$FID"
  done
  # Re-fetch for the bucket link after file deletion.
  DEPOSIT=$(curl --fail-with-body -sSL \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
    "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$DEPOSIT_ID")
else
  echo "ERROR: zenodo_newversion_of must be all digits or \"none\" (got: ${NEWVERSION_OF:-})"
  exit 1
fi

DEPOSIT_ID=$(echo "$DEPOSIT" | jq -r '.id')
BUCKET_URL=$(echo "$DEPOSIT" | jq -r '.links.bucket')
DEPOSIT_HTML=$(echo "$DEPOSIT" | jq -r '.links.html')

echo "deposit_id=$DEPOSIT_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "deposit_html=$DEPOSIT_HTML" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "bucket_url=$BUCKET_URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Zenodo draft created: $DEPOSIT_HTML (id=$DEPOSIT_ID)"

set -euo pipefail
BUCKET="${{ steps.zenodo_draft.outputs.bucket_url }}"
for f in "${{ steps.archives.outputs.tar }}" "${{ steps.archives.outputs.zip }}"; do
  name=$(basename "$f")
  echo "Uploading $name..."
  curl --fail-with-body -sSL -X PUT \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
    --upload-file "$f" \
    "$BUCKET/$name" > /tmp/upload-resp.json
  uploaded_sha=$(jq -r '.checksum' /tmp/upload-resp.json | sed 's/^md5://')
  echo "  uploaded with checksum: $uploaded_sha"
done

set -euo pipefail
DEPOSIT_ID="${{ steps.zenodo_draft.outputs.deposit_id }}"

HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sSL -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/meta-resp.json -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @artifacts-meta/zenodo-metadata-payload.json \
  "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$DEPOSIT_ID")

echo "Metadata PUT HTTP code: $HTTP_CODE"
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "200" ]; then
  echo "Metadata PUT FAILED. Response body:"
  cat /tmp/meta-resp.json
  exit 1
fi

echo "Metadata set. Title:"
jq -r '.metadata.title' /tmp/meta-resp.json
echo "Reserved DOI:"
jq -r '.metadata.prereserve_doi.doi // "(none)"' /tmp/meta-resp.json

set -euo pipefail
DEPOSIT_ID="${{ steps.zenodo_draft.outputs.deposit_id }}"

HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sSL -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/publish-resp.json -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
  "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$DEPOSIT_ID/actions/publish")

echo "Publish POST HTTP code: $HTTP_CODE"
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "202" ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "200" ]; then
  echo "Zenodo PUBLISH FAILED. Response body:"
  cat /tmp/publish-resp.json | jq . 2>/dev/null || cat /tmp/publish-resp.json
  echo ""
  echo "Diagnostic: fetching current deposit state..."
  curl -sSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
    "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$DEPOSIT_ID" \
    | jq '{ state: .state, submitted: .submitted, files: (.files | length), metadata_keys: (.metadata | keys), license: .metadata.license, language: .metadata.language, related_identifiers: .metadata.related_identifiers, missing: .metadata.errors }'
  exit 1
fi

PUBLISH=$(cat /tmp/publish-resp.json)
DOI=$(echo "$PUBLISH" | jq -r '.doi // empty')
DOI_URL=$(echo "$PUBLISH" | jq -r '.doi_url // empty')
RECORD_URL=$(echo "$PUBLISH" | jq -r '.links.record_html // .links.record // empty')

echo "doi=$DOI" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "doi_url=$DOI_URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "record_url=$RECORD_URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

echo "Zenodo PUBLISHED"
echo "DOI:       $DOI"
echo "DOI URL:   $DOI_URL"
echo "Record:    $RECORD_URL"
pip install --quiet huggingface_hub

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${HF_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: HF_TOKEN secret is not set"
  exit 1
fi
python3 << 'PY'
import os, sys
from huggingface_hub import HfApi
from huggingface_hub.utils import RepositoryNotFoundError

token = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]
repo_id = os.environ["HF_REPO_ID"]
api = HfApi(token=token)

try:
    api.repo_info(repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="dataset")
    print(f"HF repo already exists: {repo_id}")
except RepositoryNotFoundError:
    api.create_repo(repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="dataset", private=False)
    print(f"Created HF dataset repo: {repo_id}")

version = open("datasets/jam-actions-v0-public/VERSION").read().strip()
commit = api.upload_folder(
    folder_path="datasets/jam-actions-v0-public",
    repo_id=repo_id,
    repo_type="dataset",
    commit_message=f"Publish jam-actions-v0 v{version}",
)
print(f"HF push commit: {commit}")
print(f"HF URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/{repo_id}")

# Write URL to a file the next step can read
with open("/tmp/hf-url.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"https://huggingface.co/datasets/{repo_id}\n")
PY

HF_URL=$(cat /tmp/hf-url.txt | tr -d '\n')
echo "hf_url=$HF_URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

set -euo pipefail
echo "================================================================"
echo "  ${{ steps.version.outputs.pkg }} publication receipt"
echo "================================================================"
echo "  Mode:                $MODE"
if [ "$CONFIRM" = "yes-mint-doi" ]; then
  echo "  Confirmation:        yes-mint-doi"
else
  echo "  Confirmation:        NO"
fi
echo "  Dataset dir:         ${DIR:-'(unresolved)'}"
if [ "$NEWVERSION_OF" = "none" ]; then
  echo "  Zenodo path:         fresh deposit"
elif printf '%s' "${NEWVERSION_OF:-}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'; then
  echo "  Zenodo path:         new version of $NEWVERSION_OF"
else
  echo "  Zenodo path:         (invalid: ${NEWVERSION_OF:-})"
fi
echo "  Ref:                 $REF"
echo "  Version:             ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
echo "  Tar.gz sha256:       ${{ steps.archives.outputs.tar_sha }}"
echo "  Zip sha256:          ${{ steps.archives.outputs.zip_sha }}"
if [ "${SKIP_ZENODO:-}" = "true" ]; then
  echo "  Zenodo:              skipped (draft-only, no Zenodo call)"
else
  echo "  Zenodo draft URL:    ${{ steps.zenodo_draft.outputs.deposit_html }}"
  echo "  Zenodo deposit ID:   ${{ steps.zenodo_draft.outputs.deposit_id }}"
  echo "  Zenodo DOI:          ${{ steps.zenodo_publish.outputs.doi || '(not minted — draft only)' }}"
  echo "  Zenodo DOI URL:      ${{ steps.zenodo_publish.outputs.doi_url || '(not minted)' }}"
  echo "  Zenodo record:       ${{ steps.zenodo_publish.outputs.record_url || '(not minted)' }}"
fi
echo "  HuggingFace URL:     ${{ steps.hf_push.outputs.hf_url || '(not pushed)' }}"
echo "================================================================"
echo ""
echo "Tokens are NOT in this log (they live in GitHub Secrets only)."
echo "Capture the URLs above into ${DIR:-datasets/jam-actions-v0-public}/publication-receipt.json"
echo "via a follow-up local commit (NOT inside this workflow)."

set -euo pipefail
if ! printf '%s' "$REPO_ID" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$'; then
  echo "ERROR: hf_repo_id must be namespace/name (got: $REPO_ID)"
  exit 1
fi
case "$REPO_ID" in
  mcp-tool-shop/*|mcp-tool-shop-org/*)
    echo "hf_repo_id OK: $REPO_ID"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: hf_repo_id must start with 'mcp-tool-shop/' or 'mcp-tool-shop-org/' (got: $REPO_ID)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

set -euo pipefail
gh release download "$TAG" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" --pattern "$ASSET" --output adapters.tar.gz
ls -la adapters.tar.gz

commands.step: Verify asset sha256 (integrity across the release hop)
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
echo "$EXPECTED  adapters.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -

set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p upload
tar -xzf adapters.tar.gz -C upload
echo "Upload tree:"
find upload -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort
test -f upload/README.md
# The archive names its own adapters: every top-level directory must be a complete
# adapter (weights + config + receipt), and there must be at least one. The set is
# whatever the packer shipped — one 7B for jam-actions-v1, five seeds for jam-ft-v1.
n=0
for d in upload/*/; do
  s=$(basename "$d")
  test -f "upload/$s/adapter_model.safetensors" || { echo "ERROR: missing $s adapter"; exit 1; }
  test -f "upload/$s/adapter_config.json" || { echo "ERROR: missing $s config"; exit 1; }
  test -f "upload/$s/receipt.json" || { echo "ERROR: missing $s receipt"; exit 1; }
  n=$((n+1))
done
test "$n" -ge 1 || { echo "ERROR: archive holds no adapter directory"; exit 1; }
echo "$n adapter(s) + receipts + card present."
pip install --quiet huggingface_hub

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${HF_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: HF_TOKEN secret is not set"
  exit 1
fi
python3 << 'PY'
import os
from huggingface_hub import HfApi

token = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]
repo_id = os.environ["HF_REPO_ID"]
commit_msg = os.environ["HF_COMMIT_MSG"]
api = HfApi(token=token)

api.create_repo(repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="model", private=False, exist_ok=True)
print(f"HF model repo ready: {repo_id}")

commit = api.upload_folder(
    folder_path="upload",
    repo_id=repo_id,
    repo_type="model",
    commit_message=commit_msg,
)
print(f"HF push commit: {commit}")
print(f"HF URL: https://huggingface.co/{repo_id}")
PY

set -euo pipefail
if ! printf '%s' "$REPO_ID" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$'; then
  echo "ERROR: hf_repo_id must be namespace/name (got: $REPO_ID)"
  exit 1
fi
case "$REPO_ID" in
  mcp-tool-shop/*|mcp-tool-shop-org/*)
    echo "hf_repo_id OK: $REPO_ID"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: hf_repo_id must start with 'mcp-tool-shop/' or 'mcp-tool-shop-org/' (got: $REPO_ID)"
    echo "This workflow is a narrowly-scoped recovery tool for this studio's datasets only."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

set -euo pipefail
DIR="${{ github.event.inputs.dataset_dir }}"
case "$DIR" in
  datasets/*) : ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: dataset_dir must be under datasets/ (got: $DIR)"; exit 1 ;;
esac
test -d "$DIR" || { echo "ERROR: no such dataset package: $DIR"; exit 1; }

# Every package this workflow will push must carry these four. They are
# what makes a drop reproducible and attributable by someone who only
# ever sees the HuggingFace copy.
test -f "$DIR/README.md"
test -f "$DIR/VERSION"
test -f "$DIR/records.jsonl"
test -f "$DIR/checksums.sha256"

VER=$(cat "$DIR/VERSION")
echo "Pushing $DIR at version $VER"
test -d "$DIR/records" && echo "  records/ ✓"

# Checksums are the whole point of shipping them: verify before upload,
# not after, so a corrupted or half-regenerated package never leaves.
( cd "$DIR" && sha256sum -c checksums.sha256 --quiet )             && echo "  checksums verify ✓"

commands.step: Refuse to overwrite a card edited on HuggingFace
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
LOCAL="$DATASET_DIR/README.md"
REMOTE_URL="https://huggingface.co/datasets/$HF_REPO_ID/raw/main/README.md"

CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/remote-card.md -w '%{http_code}' "$REMOTE_URL" || echo 000)

# A dataset repo that does not exist yet answers 401, not 404 -- the
# Hub cannot say "no such repo" without revealing whether a private one
# exists. The push step creates the repo in exactly that case, so both
# codes mean the same thing here: there is no card to protect. Treating
# 401 as an error would have blocked every first push.
case "$CODE" in
  404|401)
    echo "No readable card on HuggingFace (HTTP $CODE) — first push. Nothing to overwrite."
    exit 0
    ;;
  200) : ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: could not read the remote card (HTTP $CODE)."
    echo "Refusing to push blind. Re-run when HuggingFace is reachable."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if cmp -s /tmp/remote-card.md "$LOCAL"; then
  echo "Remote card matches the repo. Safe to push."
  exit 0
fi

echo "================================================================"
echo "  HALT: the card on HuggingFace differs from this repo's."
echo "================================================================"
echo "  remote: $(wc -l < /tmp/remote-card.md) lines, $(wc -c < /tmp/remote-card.md) bytes"
echo "  local:  $(wc -l < "$LOCAL") lines, $(wc -c < "$LOCAL") bytes"
echo ""
echo "  Lines the remote has that the repo does not:"
diff "$LOCAL" /tmp/remote-card.md | grep '^>' | head -40 || true
echo ""
if [ "${ALLOW_CARD_OVERWRITE:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  echo "  allow_card_overwrite=true — proceeding, the remote card is discarded."
  exit 0
fi
echo "  Pushing now would DELETE the remote version of those lines."
echo ""
echo "  Either bring the remote card into the repo first, or re-run with"
echo "  allow_card_overwrite=true if the repo's card is genuinely newer."
exit 1
pip install --quiet huggingface_hub

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${HF_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: HF_TOKEN secret is not set"
  exit 1
fi
python3 << 'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
from huggingface_hub import HfApi
from huggingface_hub.utils import RepositoryNotFoundError

token = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]
repo_id = os.environ["HF_REPO_ID"]
commit_msg = os.environ["HF_COMMIT_MSG"]
api = HfApi(token=token)
# upload_folder alone only adds and overwrites. A correction release
# that REMOVES records must also delete them remotely, or the withdrawn
# files stay served beside the new version. Opt-in by exact phrase.
delete_stale = os.environ.get("DELETE_STALE", "") == "yes-delete-stale"

try:
    api.repo_info(repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="dataset")
    print(f"HF repo already exists: {repo_id}")
except RepositoryNotFoundError:
    api.create_repo(repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="dataset", private=False)
    print(f"Created HF dataset repo: {repo_id}")

if delete_stale:
    local = {p.relative_to(os.environ["DATASET_DIR"]).as_posix()
             for p in Path(os.environ["DATASET_DIR"]).rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    remote = set(api.list_repo_files(repo_id=repo_id, repo_type="dataset"))
    stale = sorted(f for f in remote - local if f != ".gitattributes")
    print(f"delete_stale: {len(stale)} remote file(s) not in the package will be deleted")
    for f in stale:
        print(f"  - {f}")

commit = api.upload_folder(
    folder_path=os.environ["DATASET_DIR"],
    repo_id=repo_id,
    repo_type="dataset",
    commit_message=commit_msg,
    delete_patterns=(["*"] if delete_stale else None),
)
print(f"HF push commit: {commit}")
print(f"HF URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/{repo_id}")

with open("/tmp/hf-url.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"https://huggingface.co/datasets/{repo_id}\n")
PY

HF_URL=$(cat /tmp/hf-url.txt | tr -d '\n')
echo "hf_url=$HF_URL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
pnpm test
pnpm pack && ls -la *.tgz

commands.step: Publish to npm with Sigstore provenance
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
PKG=$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
if npm view "$PKG@$VERSION" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "$PKG@$VERSION already on the registry — skipping publish"
else
  npm publish --provenance --access public
fi

set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "$RELEASE_TAG" ]; then
  VERSION="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
  if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: release tag '$RELEASE_TAG' is empty after stripping the leading 'v'"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi
# :latest only on a published GitHub Release, never on a retry
# workflow_dispatch of an older ref (F-9c0a63bc).
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "release" ]; then
  echo "latest=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "latest=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

set -euo pipefail
echo "record: $RECORD_ID  mode: $MODE  edit_file: $EDIT_FILE"
echo "Confirm token: <redacted>"
case "$RECORD_ID" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "ERROR: record_id must be digits"; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$EDIT_FILE" in
  docs/zenodo/*.json) ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: edit_file must be under docs/zenodo/ and end in .json"; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "$MODE" in
  preview)
    echo "-> Will GET the record and print the merged payload. No write."
    ;;
  edit-and-publish)
    if [ "$CONFIRM" != "yes-edit-record" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: mode=edit-and-publish requires confirm_irreversible=yes-edit-record"
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "-> Will put the record in edit state, replace the listed fields, and republish."
    ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: unknown mode"; exit 1 ;;
esac

set -euo pipefail
jq --version; curl --version | head -1
test -f "$EDIT_FILE" || { echo "ERROR: $EDIT_FILE not found"; exit 1; }
jq -e 'type == "object"' "$EDIT_FILE" > /dev/null || { echo "ERROR: edit file is not a JSON object"; exit 1; }
# keys that may be replaced; "$comment" is documentation and is dropped
BAD=$(jq -r 'del(.["$comment"]) | keys[] | select(. as $k | ["title","description","notes","keywords","related_identifiers","references","version","access_right","access_conditions"] | index($k) | not)' "$EDIT_FILE")
if [ -n "$BAD" ]; then echo "ERROR: keys not allowed in an edit: $BAD"; exit 1; fi
jq -e '(.title // "") | type == "string" and length > 0' "$EDIT_FILE" > /dev/null || { echo "ERROR: title must be a non-empty string"; exit 1; }
# A restriction needs its conditions, and only the two values that keep the
# record's metadata public are allowed here.
if jq -e 'has("access_right")' "$EDIT_FILE" > /dev/null; then
  jq -e '.access_right == "restricted" or .access_right == "open"' "$EDIT_FILE" > /dev/null || { echo "ERROR: access_right must be restricted or open"; exit 1; }
  if jq -e '.access_right == "restricted"' "$EDIT_FILE" > /dev/null; then
    jq -e '(.access_conditions // "") | type == "string" and length > 0' "$EDIT_FILE" > /dev/null || { echo "ERROR: restricted access needs access_conditions"; exit 1; }
  fi
fi
jq 'del(.["$comment"])' "$EDIT_FILE" > edit.json
echo "fields to replace:"; jq 'keys' edit.json
echo "new title: $(jq -r .title edit.json)"

commands.step: Fetch the published record (public API, no token)
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
CODE=$(curl -sS -o before-public.json -w '%{http_code}' --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
  "https://zenodo.org/api/records/$RECORD_ID")
test "$CODE" = "200" || { echo "ERROR: GET /api/records/$RECORD_ID -> HTTP $CODE"; cat before-public.json; exit 1; }
echo "current title: $(jq -r .metadata.title before-public.json)"
echo "current DOI:   $(jq -r .doi before-public.json)"
echo "concept DOI:   $(jq -r '.conceptdoi // "none"' before-public.json)"

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${ZEN_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo "ERROR: ZEN_TOKEN secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
CODE=$(curl -sS -o before.json -w '%{http_code}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" \
  "https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$RECORD_ID")
test "$CODE" = "200" || { echo "ERROR: GET deposition $RECORD_ID -> HTTP $CODE"; cat before.json; exit 1; }
echo "deposition state: $(jq -r .state before.json)  submitted: $(jq -r .submitted before.json)"
# the payload: every published field kept, the edit's keys replacing theirs;
# doi/prereserve_doi belong to the record and are not resubmitted
jq -n --slurpfile cur before.json --slurpfile ed edit.json \
  '{metadata: (($cur[0].metadata + $ed[0]) | del(.doi, .prereserve_doi))}' > payload.json
echo "payload keys:"; jq '.metadata | keys' payload.json
echo "payload title: $(jq -r .metadata.title payload.json)"
echo "description length: $(jq -r '.metadata.description | length' payload.json) chars"
echo "changed fields vs published:"
jq -r --slurpfile ed edit.json '
  . as $cur | $ed[0] | keys[] | . as $k
  | if ($cur.metadata[$k] == $ed[0][$k]) then "  \($k): unchanged" else "  \($k): CHANGED" end' before.json
echo "mode=preview: nothing written. Re-run with mode=edit-and-publish and the confirmation to apply."

set -euo pipefail
BASE="https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/$RECORD_ID"
discard() {
  echo "discarding the edit draft so the published record stays as it was"
  curl -sS -o discard.json -w 'discard -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" "$BASE/actions/discard" || true
}
STATE=$(jq -r .state before.json)
if [ "$STATE" = "done" ]; then
  CODE=$(curl -sS -o edit.out.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" "$BASE/actions/edit")
  case "$CODE" in 200|201) echo "edit -> HTTP $CODE (state: $(jq -r .state edit.out.json))" ;;
    *) echo "ERROR: actions/edit -> HTTP $CODE"; cat edit.out.json; exit 1 ;; esac
else
  echo "deposition already in state '$STATE'; skipping actions/edit"
fi
CODE=$(curl -sS -o put.out.json -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @payload.json "$BASE")
case "$CODE" in 200) echo "PUT metadata -> HTTP 200 (title now: $(jq -r .metadata.title put.out.json))" ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: PUT metadata -> HTTP $CODE"; cat put.out.json; discard; exit 1 ;; esac
CODE=$(curl -sS -o publish.out.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZEN_TOKEN" "$BASE/actions/publish")
case "$CODE" in 200|202) echo "publish -> HTTP $CODE  state: $(jq -r .state publish.out.json)  doi: $(jq -r .doi publish.out.json)" ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: actions/publish -> HTTP $CODE"; cat publish.out.json; discard; exit 1 ;; esac

set -euo pipefail
sleep 10
CODE=$(curl -sS -o after.json -w '%{http_code}' --retry 3 --retry-delay 10 \
  "https://zenodo.org/api/records/$RECORD_ID")
test "$CODE" = "200" || { echo "ERROR: GET /api/records/$RECORD_ID after publish -> HTTP $CODE"; exit 1; }
WANT=$(jq -r .title edit.json); GOT=$(jq -r .metadata.title after.json)
echo "live title: $GOT"
test "$GOT" = "$WANT" || { echo "ERROR: live title does not match the edit"; exit 1; }
echo "live DOI:   $(jq -r .doi after.json) (unchanged: $(jq -r .doi before-public.json))"
test "$(jq -r .doi after.json)" = "$(jq -r .doi before-public.json)" || { echo "ERROR: DOI changed"; exit 1; }
echo "OK: record $RECORD_ID republished with the edited metadata"
